text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Russian newspapers this morning. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Scandals accompany privatisation of Russia's biggest state-controlled insurance company Rosgosstrakh.
- During his visit to Kiev Russian President Boris Yeltsin enjoyed the greatest possible protocol hospitality by Ukrainian authorities.
- A top Russian diplomat intends to influence situation in Afghanistan during his visit to Pakistan.
- President Yeltsin is earning enough money for his family to live comfortably when he retires, says the paper commenting on the president's income declaration.

- In their approach to the restructuring of the energy system in Russia, the team of reformers in the government demonstrates surprising unity with the chiefs of RAO UES, the country's energy monopoly.
- The political accord signed by the presidents of Russia and Ukraine last week is a victory for the Ukrainian diplomacy, not Russian.
